note: Single source of truth for BOTH band tables — tune bounds here. `bands`: level-range → BP pacing windows, consumed by the Makeover Workbench Signifier (GET /api/meta/learnset-rubric), the learnset-suggest rubric prompt, and its soft pacing warnings; L0 rows (on-evolution rewards) and status moves are exempt. `coverage_bands`: BP → band edges for the coverage matrix and ladder scripts (scripts/move_coverage.py derives MIN_LADDER_POWER, BAND_EDGES, and BAND_LABELS from it; labels must keep matching its BAND_CONVENTIONS keys). The two tables are deliberately separate mappings: recutting one does not recut the other.
